key_points: No material fundamental news: headlines consist almost entirely of options chain data, generic 'best stocks' lists, and social-media chatter
Stocktwits mentions of 52-week highs and a Michael Burry position are unverified and not SEC-filed; treat as noise
Single valuation opinion (Simply Wall Street) calling VLO 44% overvalued is one analyst view with no new data
No earnings, guidance, M&A, regulatory, or operational announcements in the feed
Short-term price momentum may persist but offers no thesis update for a long-term investor
